settings_approvals_intro: Decide whether posts need an approval before they go out.
settings_allow_self: Requesters can approve their own posts
settings_conflict: Someone else changed these settings. The latest version is shown.
settings_read_only: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
settings_defaults: Nothing saved yet: these are the defaults.
settings_email_failures_hint: Posts that fail or need you to post manually
settings_email_channels_hint: Channels that need reconnecting or are about to expire
settings_in_app_note: In-app notifications always show in the bell.
settings_email_failed: Your notification settings weren't saved. Try again.
settings_name_failed: Your name wasn't saved. Try again.
settings_password_two_factor: Changing the password isn't available yet for accounts with two-factor sign-in.
settings_password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings_password_failed: Your password wasn't changed. Try again.
system_incidents_empty: No incidents in the last 7 days.
settings_tags_intro: Internal labels for finding and grouping posts. They are never published.
settings_tags_empty: No tags yet. Add one in the composer or on a post.

match.countPlural=one: It will be removed from {count} post.
match.countPlural=*: It will be removed from {count} posts.

settings_saved_texts_intro: Reusable text for the whole workspace, such as a signature or a template. Insert it while writing a post.
settings_saved_text_delete_body: Posts that already used it keep their text.
settings_saved_text_exists: A saved text with this name already exists.
settings_saved_text_limit: This workspace has reached its limit of saved texts. Delete one first.
settings_saved_text_name_invalid: This name is empty or too long.
settings_saved_text_invalid: This text is empty or too long.

match.countPlural=one: {count} channel loses it as its signature.
match.countPlural=*: {count} channels lose it as their signature.

settings_feeds_intro: Turn each new item of an RSS or Atom feed, such as a blog or a newsletter, into a post on your channels.
settings_feed_channels_hint: Only channels that can post text alone or text with one image are listed.
settings_feed_no_channels: No channel can post text alone or text with one image yet. Connect one first.
settings_feed_channels_image_hint: Channels that need an image, such as Instagram, get only the items that have one.
settings_feed_placeholder_summary: a short summary of the item, up to 500 characters
settings_feed_delete_body: Posts it has already made stay as they are.

match.reason=owner_lost: Paused: whoever saved it last can no longer schedule posts
match.reason=fetch_failing: Paused: the feed has failed for 24 hours

match.kind=url_blocked: Last check failed: this address isn't allowed.
match.kind=fetch_failed: Last check failed: the feed couldn't be fetched.
match.kind=timed_out: Last check failed: the feed took too long to answer.
match.kind=too_large: Last check failed: the feed is too large.
match.kind=feed_invalid: Last check failed: the link isn't an RSS or Atom feed.

settings_feed_url_invalid: Enter an https link without a user name or password.
settings_feed_unreachable: The feed couldn't be fetched. Check the link and try again.
settings_feed_invalid: This link isn't an RSS or Atom feed.
settings_feed_name_invalid: The name is empty or too long.
settings_feed_template_invalid: The post text is empty or too long.
settings_feed_channel_gone: One of the channels no longer exists.
settings_feed_channel_unsupported: {channel} can post neither text alone nor text with one image.
settings_feed_channel_queue: {channel} has no queue times. Add some on the Channels page, or save new items as drafts.
settings_feed_limit: This workspace has reached its limit of feeds. Delete one first.
settings_short_links_intro: Shorten the links in scheduled posts through Dub or Kutt, with one short link per channel and UTM tags added. If the shortener can't be reached, a link is published as written.
settings_short_links_api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the current key. A new address needs the key again.
settings_short_links_remove_body: Posts scheduled from now on keep their long links. Short links that already exist keep working.
settings_short_links_unauthorized: The service refused this API key.
settings_short_links_unreachable: The service couldn't be reached. Check the address and try again.
settings_short_links_base_url_invalid: Enter an https link, such as https://kutt.to or your own instance, without a user name, password or query. kutt.it isn't supported.
settings_short_links_domain_invalid: Enter a host name such as go.example.com, without https:// or a path.
settings_short_links_api_key_invalid: The API key is too long or has characters that aren't allowed.
settings_short_links_api_key_required: A new address needs the API key again.
settings_short_links_conflict: The shortener was changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
settings_brand_list_intro: Group channels by client or brand. Each brand can have its own approval rules.
settings_brand_name_taken: A brand with this name already exists.
settings_brand_in_use: This brand still has channels. Move its channels first.
settings_brand_name_invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 120 characters.
settings_brand_override_removed: The brand follows the workspace rules again.
settings_brand_strictest: A post that goes to channels of several brands follows the strictest rules among its channels.
settings_groups_intro: Save channels you often post to together as a group. In the composer, a group adds all its channels at once. Groups never change who can see or do what.
settings_group_delete_body: Posts keep their channels. Only the group goes away.
settings_group_name_taken: A group with this name already exists.
settings_group_name_invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 120 characters.
